title: RddQuickContext (per ADR-0048)
description: Temporary context file passed from rdd-builder P0 选项 5 to rdd-quick. Per ADR-0048 §Decision 3, this file is created when dispatch-quick is triggered, consumed by rdd-quick during execution, and deleted by rdd-quick on completion (escalated/completed/unverified).

proposal_path.description: Relative path from project_root to openspec/changes/<change>/proposal.md

from_builder.description: Always true; distinguishes builder-dispatched quick from direct guide-recommended quick (which doesn't create this file).

planner_advisory.description: Snapshot of .planner-handoff.json::recommended_route at dispatch time (audit trail).

ac_count.description: Number of acceptance criteria in proposal.md ## 验收标准 (for audit; rdd-quick may use for P1 fallback triage).
